academyInfo.aboutText: Vendhan Sports Academy is a premier high-performance sports training institution dedicated to nurturing discipline, athletic excellence, and championship spirit. Equipped with professional synthetic roller skating rinks, FIFA-standard artificial turf, an Olympic 70m archery range, a dedicated mindful yoga shala, and comprehensive biomechanical fitness suites, we provide world-class coaching for all age categories.
